items.title: Drag from the grip
items.sentence: The dotted grip is the part of the row that starts a drag. The title stays put so you can still read it.

items.title: Pages keep their children
items.sentence: A page with children shows an arrow after the title. Open it to drag the pages nested under that parent.

items.title: One list, then the public page
items.sentence: Saving an order in the admin does not change the public site until that list is set to menu order.
